name: llyfr
title: Llyfr
description: Search and manage a local BibTeX library of papers, and import entries and PDFs from NASA ADS (requires a free ADS API token).

commands.name: llyfr
commands.title: Search Library
commands.subtitle: Llyfr
commands.description: Display list of papers in the local library

preferences.title: Library Folder
preferences.description: Folder where the PDFs of your library are stored
